entry.title: Bank of America Plaza
entry.note: Exact-QID shaft and independently mapped three-level west wing retain the signed diagonal frame. Three mapped tower door nodes match the corner portals. Shaft local dimensions are regularized by less than one metre where the map ring is irregular; physical Y0 is local ground contact. Upper setbacks, portal offsets and low paving/stair grades are primary-photo reconstruction. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
